_comment: Typo corrections applied to post titles and body text on import. These are genuine errors in the published Medium copy; everything else is left verbatim. Kept here rather than hand-edited into content/blog/*.md so a rerun of the importer can't silently reintroduce them. `find` is matched literally, not as a regex.
